acceptance_scope: Implement UI/forms/tables/selectors/UI permissions/loading-empty-error/responsive-accessibility when applicable; point scope is webhook signature, validation, replay protection, idempotency and logging; if frontend does not apply, document N/A.

applicability.reason: The N7.5 webhook flow implemented by N7.5.D is an inbound machine-to-machine endpoint. Signature validation, provider normalization, replay/idempotency decisions and correlation handling execute server-side. The active contract exposes no authenticated management/configuration API for webhook secrets or inbound-event administration that a frontend could safely consume. The secret is read from server IConfiguration and is never a browser-facing datum. Creating a screen, form or placeholder would invent an unsupported contract, risk implying secret management in the browser, and violate VAEP no-filler/no-duplicate rules.
applicability.shell_reuse_check: Existing app shell/header/navigation/dashboard already exists; no duplicate shell was introduced.
applicability.third_party_placeholder: Not created because there is no user-facing contract requiring one.

security_observations: Inbound endpoint validates HMAC SHA-256 server-side using X-Webhook-Signature.
Webhook secret is sourced from Webhooks:{empresaId}:{provider}:Secret in server configuration, not from frontend state.
Duplicate/replay decisions are tenant/provider/external-event scoped and returned by the API without exposing the secret.
